Rufus Reid has made his mark in the jazz world as a bassist, educator and composer. His lengthy list of musical associates include the Thad Jones/Mel Lewis Orchestra, Dexter Gordon and Eddie Harris, and Rufus now leads his own “Out Front” Trio. He created the Jazz Studies program at William Paterson University with Dr. Martin Krivin, and authored The Evolving Bassist method book and DVD.
Rufus was interviewed in Atlanta, GA, on January 4, 2013, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
